Dear Mr Hadley,

Thank you for your message. We would like to renew for another year, and we have been happy in the flat. We have paid on time every month for the past three years.

We understand that your costs have risen and that you have your own mortgage to cover. We are also aware that the rent has not changed during our tenancy, so we accept that an increase is fair.

We are not able to agree to £1,450 a month, but we could agree to £1,400 a month for the renewal. That is a clear increase, and it would help us stay in a home that is close to the school, which matters a great deal for our family.

Could you let us know whether £1,400 would work for you? We are happy to discuss this further if it helps.

Kind regards,

John
